searchText: Is the doc [here](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/eof-devnet-0) up to date? Specifically, the exec spec test release? TLDR: PeerDAS is starting to incorporate changes that need the EL, so its easier for us to build on top of a "snapshot" of the EL that's considered stable. So i'd like to propose all ELs build on top of exec spec tests eip7692@2.1.0 (if thats latest), that way we can proceed with blob increase testing (gas schedule needs fulu on the EL side) as well as cell proof computation changes without needing to keep up with EOF. Once eof-devnet-1 is done and feature frozen, we can bump the EL peerDAS branch again and eventually discuss merging everything in. There's a newer release https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/eip7692%40v2.2.0. Otherwise up-to-date for eof-devnet-0. eof-devnet-1 is planned have a bunch of updates on top updated 🙂 Hello <@547171287831805972> I would like to know if I could contribute these two issues, thank you! https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/issues/695 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/issues/1005 Thanks for reaching out Louis! <@425274498732916736> could you please check the status of these issues - Louis would love to contribute to an EOF-related test! sorry <@403707149043105803>, I think you saw what I wrote, turns out I was comparing valid_index with invalid_index, thinking that both were valid_index tests in `eofcreate/returncontract`, but there is still weird thing that, for some reason only valid_255 doest not pass, anyways looking into that

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
Is the doc [here](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/eof-devnet-0) up to date? Specifically, the exec spec test release?

TLDR: PeerDAS is starting to incorporate changes that need the EL, so its easier for us to build on top of a "snapshot" of the EL that's considered stable. 

So i'd like to propose all ELs build on top of exec spec tests eip7692@2.1.0 (if thats latest), that way we can proceed with blob increase testing (gas schedule needs fulu on the EL side) as well as cell proof computation changes without needing to keep up with EOF. Once eof-devnet-1 is done and feature frozen, we can bump the EL peerDAS branch again and eventually discuss merging everything in.
